params.name: id
params.desc: 业务短 ID, 格式 <RENDERTYPE>_<FLOORNAME>_<SEQ>, 例如 'WINDOW_A_6F_1' / 'DOOR_B_24F_3'。fallback 也支持 findId (A_6F_mesh_42)

code: const obj = ssp.objectsTool.getById('CEILING_A_6F_1'); if (obj) console.log('found sid:', obj.userData.sid, 'renderType:', obj.userData.renderType); else console.log('not found');
example: const obj = ssp.objectsTool.getById('DOOR_A_6F_1'); if (obj) await ssp.cameraController.flyToObject(obj);
guard: 可能返回 null, 必须检查
